description.value: RavenSong Soap & Candle is an Indigenous-owned artisan shop on Vancouver Island specializing in handcrafted soaps, candles, bath products, and essential oils rooted in Northwest Coast storytelling and ceremony. The brand weaves cultural narrative into every product line, from Full Moon Ritual soaps to Northwest Coast Art Bars, and features work by Indigenous artists. A second retail location is opening in Downtown Campbell River, with the existing Willow Point store remaining open.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and functional, confirming RavenSong Soap & Candle is a real, operating business with a physical retail presence in the Willow Point area (and an upcoming second location in Downtown Campbell River). No OSM tags are present beyond coordinates and URL, so all amenity evidence must come from the website, which contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific facilities. The site is primarily an e-commerce and retail soap/candle brand with Indigenous storytelling themes.
